notes: Table numbers are positions in the hash-checked S-1 HTML. The unit line sits in the caption above the F-page tables, so captions are checked as well as headers.
The model selects the two rows the house figure is computed from (house_operating_income); code reads the rest of Anthropic's bridge (table 61) to recompute Anthropic's own figure first.
The dash on the settlement row is read as nil only because that row declares blank_is_zero.

column.note: column under 'Six Months Ended June 30,' and the period-end year; not the comparative six months or a fiscal year

61.note: Anthropic's own Adjusted Operating Income reconciliation

operating_cash_flow.label: Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities

fv_convertibles.label: Change in fair value of convertible notes, derivative liabilities, and SAFEs

revenue.label: Revenue, six months ended 30 June 2026
revenue.reconciliation: Matches the total of the S-1's revenue disaggregation note

net_loss.label: Net loss, six months ended 30 June 2026
net_loss.reconciliation: Matches the net loss the S-1's cash flow statement starts from

operating_cash_flow.label: Operating cash flow, six months ended 30 June 2026
operating_cash_flow.reconciliation: Matches the S-1's MD&A cash flow summary

capex.label: Capital expenditure (purchases of property and equipment), six months ended 30 June 2026
capex.reconciliation: Single archived cell; the S-1 totals it nowhere else

simple_fcf.label: Simple free cash flow (operating cash flow minus purchases of property and equipment; Anthropic does not define free cash flow)
simple_fcf.reconciliation: Different definition: Anthropic reports no free cash flow, so there is no issuer figure to match

house_operating_income.label: Operating result under our method, six months ended 30 June 2026 (method rule M-1: stock compensation is a cost)
show: of which, non-cash charge on convertible notes

verify.label: Anthropic's Adjusted Operating Income, recomputed from its own bridge

house_operating_income.reconciliation: Anthropic's adjusted figure recomputes exactly from its own bridge; our figure differs from it only by stock compensation, which method rule M-1 never adds back
house_operating_income.query: Adjusted Operating Income (Loss) reconciliation, Six Months Ended June 30, 2026: Operating loss; Stock-based compensation expense; Non-cash charitable contributions; Adjusted Operating Income (Loss).

query: Consolidated Statements of Operations and Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, Six Months Ended June 30, 2026: Revenue; Net loss; Net cash provided by (used in) operating activities; Purchases of property and equipment.
model_note: Use ONLY the last column, Six Months Ended June 30, 2026, never a fiscal year column or the six months ended June 30, 2025 comparative.
